 Here are the Predictions for Nepal Premier League 2026, 5th Match - Janakpur Bolts vs Kathmandu Gorkhas and 6th Match - Karnali Yaks vs Biratnagar Kings, to be played on the 29th of October at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur.
 Match Prediction - Janakpur Bolts v Kathmandu Gorkhas 
 LIVE SCORES - 5th Match - Janakpur Bolts vs Kathmandu Gorkhas (Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 157
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 137
 Current Form Janakpur Bolts: 
 Janakpur Bolts are currently placed at the 7th position on points table with 1 loss to their credit.
 The top run scorer for Janakpur Bolts in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Abhisekh Tiwari with 20 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Janakpur Bolts in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Harmeet Singh with 3 scalps under his belt .
 Janakpur Bolts have lost their previous match against Karnali Yaks by 19 runs.
 Karnali Yaks batted first and they posted a total of 132 for 9 in 20 overs. Mark Watt, Deepak Dumre and Hussain Talat got out without troubling the scorers much. After their dismissals, Ariful Islam and Pawan Sarraf played well. Islam made 43 runs off 29 balls while Sarraf scored a run a ball 37. The pitch was really difficult to bat on. Wickets kept falling in regular succession and Karnali Yaks had to settle for a total of 132 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Janakpur Bolts lost their way right from the word go. They were reduced to 57 for 5 in the 10th over itself. The lower order batters including Jimmy Neesham, Harmeet Singh and Abhisekh Tiwari all got starts but failed to stretch their innings and win it for the team. Hussain Talat and Unish Bikram Singh were the stars with the ball. They both picked up 3 wickets and Janakpur Bolts were eventually bowled out for just 113, losing the match by 19 runs.
 Current Form Kathmandu Gorkhas: 
 Kathmandu Gorkhas performed well in the last edition of Nepal Premier League. They managed to qualify for the Playoffs but lost to Lumbini Lions in the Eliminator Match.
 The top run scorer for Kathmandu Gorkhas in the last edition of Nepal Premier League was Ben Charlesworth with 201 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Kathmandu Gorkhas in the last edition of Nepal Premier League was Shahab Alam with 13 scalps under his belt .
 Kathmandu Gorkhas have a good mix of experienced as well as young talented players. David Warner, Karan KC and Bhim Sharki are part of the squad. Kathmandu Gorkhas aren't the strongest of the sides and they will have to play their A game in order to pose sort of challenge to the other teams in the competition.
 Players to look out for: 
 1. David Warner - When Warner hits, he hits them a long way. Warner is going to be key for Kathmandu Gorkhas with bat in the current edition of Nepal Premier League.
 2. Karan KC - He is one of the best seamers in Nepal cricket. KC has plenty of variations in his bowling arsenal. He will play a key role for Kathmandu Gorkhas in the upcoming matches with the ball in hand

 The top wicket taker for Biratnagar Kings in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Angelo Matthews with 1 scalp under his belt .
 Biratnagar Kings have lost their previous match against Chitwan Rhinos by 8 runs.
 Chitwan Rhinos batted first and they posted a total of 157 for 3 in 20 overs. Dev Khanal and Dawid Malan started off very well for Chitwan Rhinos. Malan was the aggressor in the partnership. They collected 58 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Khanal made 12 while Malan went on to score 70 runs in only 50 balls, hitting 5 fours and 5 sixes. Ravi Bopara and Dan Mousley also contributed healthily, scoring 31 and 29 runs respectively to help Chitwan Rhinos get to 157 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Imran Sheikh and Lokesh Bam began very well. Sheikh made 39 runs while Bam scored 26 runs but both of them got out at a wrong time. After their dismissals, the middle order struggled a lot. Andre Russell smashed 33 off 17 balls but he also threw it away. The lower order failed to produce any impact and Biratnagar Kings were eventually bowled out for 149, losing the match by 8 runs.
